paired_comparison.interpretation: Best-within-budget uses ANN epoch5 and SNN epoch4; do not call this difference an isolated quantization loss or statistical equivalence.

observations: Both models learn: ANN loss 0.7593 -> 0.5930 and IoU 37.22% -> 45.81%; SNN loss 0.7738 -> 0.6125 and best IoU 45.58% at epoch4, then44.52% at epoch5.
ANN epoch4 -> epoch5 gains only0.0489 pp IoU while SNN loses1.0611 pp. One late dip does not establish convergence.

Ordinary IoU improves, high-density IoU falls. Even the diagnostic high-density maximum over the25 existing thresholds declines from25.06% ->19.39% (ANN) and25.73% ->19.67% (SNN). Selected overall thresholds are interior.
About96.3% of false positives are high-density. Shared Proposal recall is98.42%; most false negatives occur in the new Refiner.
Same-epoch4, same-threshold ANN/SNN IoU differs by0.1823 pp; the roughly33.5 pp teacher gap already appears in ANN. Investigate the shared replacement Refiner first, not solely quantization.
Finite-value advisories do not stop or clip outputs. Optimizer gradient clipping affected0.0963% /0.3852% of epoch5 backward passes.
GPU-resident data has zero per-batch disk reads and input H2D bytes. Input dispatch is about1.8% of epoch5 train time; no evidence memory/data-loading constraints explain poor accuracy.
Dense GPU convolutions remain; ideal spike AC is hypothetical, and end-to-end MAC/energy savings have not been established.
hypotheses_not_proven: Common10ms aggregation, bounded count encoding, state/readout and loss weighting may limit dense-background separation. These logs do not isolate causal contributions.
High-density Dev degradation with falling training loss is compatible with optimization/generalization imbalance; not proof of a particular overfitting mechanism.

decision.recommendation: Preserve both best/last/epoch5 checkpoints. Do not automatically extend unchanged grid Refiner to30epochs; pause extra budget for this branch. Prioritize a faithful frozen-H2-pro feature/MLP conversion baseline or a targeted diagnostic before a new architecture.
decision.ann_state: Remain paused; no resume or mutation.
decision.caveat: Research-budget prioritization, not proof of convergence or impossibility. Single seed, five epochs; epoch5 LR still95.72% of initial under original30epoch schedule.
decision.what_would_change_recommendation: A controlled diagnostic recovering high-density discrimination, or useful continuing learning without worsening dense-scene errors; further training remains a user decision.

preservation.includes: Source identity files and existing suite results/logs/checkpoints for all three arms.
